scenes.title: Three Stones North
scenes.summary: At dawn on Saturday before the upstairs guests wake, Kira, Matvey, and Yaroslav count three flat flagstones north from the courtyard shade tree.

scenes.title: Wrapped in Waxed Cloth
scenes.summary: Zoya brings hot morning coffee from the kitchen just as Matvey lifts the third stone and uncovers a dry parcel wrapped in heavy waxed cloth.

scenes.title: The Biscuit Tin
scenes.summary: Inside sunlit Room 9, Kira, Zoya, and Yaroslav untie the waxed cloth to reveal a painted red-and-gold biscuit tin sealed thirty summers ago.

scenes.title: The Brass Compass
scenes.summary: Matvey eases open the stiff tin lid with a drop of oil, and he and Kira discover a shining brass pocket compass resting on top.

scenes.title: Four Illustrated Cards
scenes.summary: Room 4 guest Larisa and architect Roman examine four watercolour clue cards from the tin, and Roman recognises the signature mark of his retired cartography professor.

scenes.title: Half of a Cake Recipe
scenes.summary: In the café corner, Zoya, Larisa, and Gleb read a neatly torn card holding only the top half of the famous summer berry-and-almond cake recipe.

scenes.title: Five Young Friends
scenes.summary: Yaroslav, Larisa, and Roman admire a thirty-year-old charcoal sketch from the bottom of the tin showing five smiling friends around a courtyard table.

scenes.title: Walk All Four Clues First
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Kira, Matvey, and Roman inspect a small wax-sealed envelope instructing them to walk all four neighbourhood clues along Lipovy Lane before breaking the seal.
